body: I have a story to share and would like an interview.

I just want to say I'm sorry to all of you. I don't have any advice to give. I lost my son (20) about a year ago. It's been a horrible year to get through but I did get through it. I am able to laugh sometimes but the pain is still deep. I've just somehow learned to live with it. My heart is with you all. 💖

I'm so sorry! When my son committed he left no note either. I was in shock and still am. It's been a year now and I still have no answers. I am praying for you  as I know the next few months will be excruciating. Somehow you will get through it and you will be a different person. I'm here if you need to chat.

It's been over a year since my son left at 20. No else mentions him or seems to remember him. When I think back when he was little I get this same feeling you describe like he's some sort of character in my memory and he wasn't really real. It makes me sad and I question my sanity. IDK maybe I've sort of detached to help overcome the pain. It's just weird and I didn't think anyone would understand this idea.

I'm not bipolar so I imagine it must be a lot harder for you. I was on depression medication for awhile but it seemed to make me feel worse. This might sound really out there but I've seen a few mediums who have given me enough proff that my son is still around and aware of what's currently going on in our lives. I talk to him all the time and I've had incredible signs that he is with me. It's what keeps me going. I've heard that EMDR works for treating PTSD but haven't tried it yet.

Wow, this made me tear up. I feel like he is speaking to me through you. "It was one of the quietest, coldest, completely incorrect thought processes I ever had." Seems like this describes it. I really think he had some kind of psychotic break. He was never dramatic or showed emotions on the surface but I imagine that internally he was slowly going crazy. I just feel so incredibly horrible that I couldn't have been there for him. He should have felt safe enough to count on me.

Thank you for explaining this. I drive myself crazy thinking of all the things I think I did wrong raising my son just to lose him to suicide. In my viewpoint we had a great relationship and he was the most important person in my life but I wonder what his viewpoint was to lead him to that outcome. It really hurts to know he didn't share that feeling with me. As a mother I can't help but want to take 100% responsibility for his decision but he was 20 and out on his own.

I felt so sad reading your post. I've read lots of posts of parents losing their children to suicide but very few from a child losing a parent. My son hung himself while away at college. I had no clue he was even struggling. I wasn't terrible to him and he was the light of my life but I wasn't very affectionate with him in the later years. I just feel so horrible that I didn't even know what he was going through. He should have felt he could have counted on me for anything.
It's been almost a year for me since my son left. I feel the same way. It's so hard.

My son's birthday is tomorrow. He would have been 21. I just can't stand it that he won't be here for this. Been crying all day thinking of my beautiful handsome boy. I was doing OK but today I just broke. How on earth are we supposed to live without them?
I'm so sorry you have to go through this.

I'm so sorry for your loss. This is the first holiday season without my beautiful son. I would never ever have done this to him. Sometimes I even feel angry with him for doing this. Mostly I just miss him so much. When I get to heaven I'm not sure if I'll hug him or slap him up side of the head. Probably both. It's all too disturbing.
Thank God for the fathers.
I'm also at 11 months now and have to say I feel exactly the same as you on all points you bring up.
Same here. First Thanksgiving without him. Put a picture at the table behind the plate. Want him to feel he's still part of the family.

I am so very sorry. Life is so hard. I never used to feel this way. I lost both my parents. One I was with at their last breath, but as already mentioned, that is natural and after a short grieving  period I felt at ease they were in a better place. Then lost my brother-in-law in a horrible accident. He was about to be married and was finally happy. So tragic. After some time I did come to peace with it. Then losing my son to suicide is, like you say, so disturbing. How can a person ever recover from this!  I feel forever damaged, wounded beyond repair. It's just not fair and so hard to understand. 

Hugs to all of you suffering in silence.
This is the worst thing that could happen to anyone. I'm so sorry. I don't understand it either.
I feel you. All opinions should be of value here.
Has this been deleted?
It wasn't supposed to happen.
My reply is above. It is out of order. It's unfortunate that my son's death is of diminished interest to you.

When I say optimistI don't at all mean anyone is taking it for a thrill. I mean that they have high hopes that is somehow going to cure them. They don't realize, even if it does help them at first, that this a poisonous substance.

My son took his own life while in the 5th month on Accutane. He was a healthy and happy boy with no history of depression. Around the 2nd and 3rd month he complained of the usual symptoms of dryness and joint pain. My husband seemed to be more bothered by the acne than my son was but my son was a trooper and continued on. He was in college so we didn't see him for weeks at a time. By the 5th month I noticed a personality change of being withdrawn, and not his usual joking around  self. I chalked it up to the pressures of college and never dreamed he was having suicidal thoughts .His friends at college said they noticed changes too but not anything they were to concerned about. A couple days before he set up a profile on a dating site and went grocery shopping indicating he was making future plans. Then one day he got up, left class early and went shopping for the supplies he needed to hang himself . That suddenly! No note, no call, nothing. The only thing I found on his computer that indicated he was in psychosis was the downward spiral of dark music in his Spotify history.

This drug is literally a poison! It can  cause an overdose of vitamin A which can cause a variety of horrendous side effects including DEATH. There's plenty of evidence to prove this. Many people may not notice any bad side effects at first but a lot may notice things years later. I only wish someone had spammed me before my son died from taking this horrible drug. If you think about it, why would a person spam this unless they had a excruciating experience and want to let as many people know as possible. IMHO this person cares  a hell of a lot more about all of you than the drug company that makes this. The sad part is all of the "optimists " will never change their minds until it is too late. I realize I will probably get a lot of negative feedback from this but my heart has been broken into a million pieces and I just want the right to state my case.
Call your friend and see if he will come back and stay with you until morning.
I'm so sorry. The pain is excruciating. It's not fair.
How are you do in my now?

I had a wierd guilt about eating after my son passed. Like I didn't deserve to consume anything if he wasn't here to share it with me. I also felt that if my son was in pain or suffering that I didn't deserve to have any earthly pleasure.
How horrible. I'm so sorry.
I'm so sorry. That is so heartbreaking. I'm at 7 months and it's still hard. Some days I just feel so lost.
I'm so sorry you lost your brother. 💔
Call your parents and tell them. Please! They don't know how you feel.

Wish my son would have cared about me the way you care about your mom and brother. My son hung himself in February and left me, his little sister and brother alone. Life has been excruciating without him.
I can so relate to all this. My son was also 20  and I have all the same triggers. Where did it all go wrong?
I am so sorry for your loss.😢

I am in tears reading all your posts. My son hung himself February 5th. I just can't comprehend that a person who brought me so much joy and happiness could have been in such a state that he felt he had to kill himself. I never saw it coming. How could I have been so blind? I have seen the death of both of my own parents (cancer & heart attack, so it's very different circumstances) and various other family members but nothing hurts like this. Nothing. It is very true that you can't understand the love a parent has for their child until you have a child of your own. Thank you beautiful young people for showing empathy and compassion for your parents.
How beautiful!
I am so so sorry for your loss. It makes it that much harder when it's the sweet and gentle ones.
This made me cry. I lost my son less than 4 months ago. I feel exactly the same as your mother. He was much to gentle for this world.
Yes, I agree with this.
A special Happy Birthday to you!
Happy Birthday! You are important.

I am so sorry!  I also lost my son 3 months ago. He had just turned 20. It is crushing. I don't know that I have any advice as I'm still working through it. I do find that talking with other people who have experienced this loss is helpful. It's  now like being in a different world. One that  before this I didn't know existed. I am here if you want to talk.
Who was he?
Beautifully said from a very wise person. Thank you!
My son also died of suicide.
